pr_title: ddl, test: fix deadloop in test about doDDLJob
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #19798 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed: revert some changes made in #18844, which may cause deadloop 

How it works: #18844 faces a problem of data race at `d.ctx`, in fact add `// +build !race` is enough, other changes wrongly changed the behaviour of ddl workers and `doDDLJobs`, which may cause a deadloop and weaken the code.

NOTE that `doDDLJob` will block if ddl worker accidentally exit (but stop block if restart later), at waiting `task.err` channel. If we want to resolve this block, such as exit when context canceled, it will cause restarted ddl worker of the sending end's block. Sending end's block can't be resolved by detecting context canceled in same way, because `d.ctx` may be replaced thus new context is not canceled at that time.
So I just hope ddl worker won't accidentally exit

issue_context.title: `testRunInterruptedJob` may cause deadlock
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

diff:

```
diff --git a/ddl/ddl.go b/ddl/ddl.go
index 755e972b0..98d2635b1 100644
--- a/ddl/ddl.go
+++ b/ddl/ddl.go
@@ -460,6 +460,7 @@ func (d *ddl) asyncNotifyWorker(jobTp model.ActionType) {
 }

 func (d *ddl) doDDLJob(ctx sessionctx.Context, job *model.Job) error {
+       time.Sleep(1 * time.Second)
        if isChanClosed(d.ctx.Done()) {
                return d.ctx.Err()
        }
diff --git a/ddl/restart_test.go b/ddl/restart_test.go
index 489f635ec..66b8d09f9 100644
--- a/ddl/restart_test.go
+++ b/ddl/restart_test.go
@@ -161,6 +161,7 @@ LOOP:
                select {
                case <-ticker.C:
                        d.Stop()
+                       time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
                        c.Assert(s.getDDLSchemaVer(c, d), GreaterEqual, ver)
                        d.restartWorkers(context.Background())
                        time.Sleep(time.Millisecond * 20)
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

test pass

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

deadlock

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
